items.title: Moonshot AI publishes Kimi K3's full weights — the largest open-weight model release ever
items.summary: At 00:00 UTC on July 27, Moonshot AI published the complete weights for Kimi K3 on Hugging Face under a Modified MIT license: a 2.8-trillion-parameter model, roughly 1.4TB using MXFP4 quantization. Kimi K3 had only been reachable via Moonshot's hosted API and the kimi.com consumer app since July 16; this is the first point any organization with sufficient infrastructure can download, inspect, fine-tune, and self-host it directly.
items.whyItMatters: A frontier-scale model becoming fully self-hostable (not just API-accessible) is a real, if heavyweight, option for a cheaper or China-independent LLM backend behind Romain/Anna, especially once the community ships smaller distilled or further-quantized variants.

items.title: DeepSeek suspends its ~$74B-valuation funding round after founder's remarks go viral
items.summary: DeepSeek told prospective investors it is pausing its second fundraising round, which had targeted roughly a 500-billion-yuan ($74B) valuation following its $7.4B first round, after online reports of founder Liang Wenfeng's candid comments on China's AI lag and reliance on Nvidia chips circulated widely. The company may resume the process later; no deal has been cancelled outright.
items.whyItMatters: DeepSeek's models are among the cheapest capable LLM options for cost-sensitive backend work, so a stalled raise is worth tracking as a leading indicator of whether its rapid price cuts and release cadence continue.
